_note: What you see: Do Not Track and a consent requirement are honoured. The fixed page with the cookie statement.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Do Not Track en een toestemmingsvereiste worden gehonoreerd. De vaste pagina met de cookieverklaring.
Deze website gebruikt alleen cookies die: This website only uses cookies needed to sign in. We do not track you.
U hoeft niets te kiezen: You do not have to choose anything
Geen cookies voor reclame of om u te vol: No cookies for advertising or to track you. That is why we do not ask for consent. If your browser sends Do Not Track, we do not count your visit at all. If a portal does ask for consent, we only measure after you have said yes.
Om u veilig te laten inloggen, bewaren w: To let you sign in safely, we store a few small things in your browser. Without this data, My Zuiddrecht does not work.
Wat deze website in uw browser bewaart: What this website stores in your browser
Houdt u ingelogd als u van pagina naar p: Keeps you signed in as you move from page to page in My Zuiddrecht.
Tot u uitlogt of uw browser sluit: Until you sign out or close your browser
Bewijst bij elke vraag aan de server dat: Proves it is you with every request to the server. Only in this tab.
Als u via een campagne binnenkwam, ontho: If you came in through a campaign, we remember which one. We only send that along when you submit a form.
Wij tellen bezoeken zonder cookies. Wij: We count visits without cookies. That way we cannot recognise you on a next visit.
Video's van YouTube laden wij zonder hun: We load YouTube videos without their advertising cookies, via youtube-nocookie.com.
Wij delen niets met advertentiebedrijven: We share nothing with advertising companies.
U kunt cookies altijd zelf weghalen in d: You can always remove cookies yourself in your browser settings. After that you simply sign in again.
